title: Knowledge-Base Practicality for Cybersecurity Research Ethics Evaluation
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the evaluation of research ethics. It proposes and tests a knowledge-base (KB) system as a tool for conducting ethical analyses of cybersecurity research, comparing its performance against expert reviews using established ethical standards. The entire study is a deep-dive into the methodology and effectiveness of ethics evaluation, making it the core subject of the paper rather than a brief, secondary consideration.
